answer: To spin up a sybil, an attacker must acquire fresh hardware, pay the full stake per identity, and burn compute on each nonce; the marginal ember of profit per fake identity stays below the cost, so mass registration becomes unprofitable and detectable. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit locked to a verified hardware inlet, and registration burns a unique proof-of-work nonce seeded by the prior epoch's dune hash. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
